text: dsh-token-billing 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 计费插件，在输入框下方显示本会话及工作区费用，并提供全部会话汇总。插件读取模型调用的用量，按内置 flash、pro 价格及北京时间高峰/空闲时段计算成本；未列价模型不计费。账本存入 token_billing storage-domain，重启后恢复。悬停读数可查看 token 用量、分模型统计、工作区和价格表。使用需要提供 webServer、storageDomain 的 Web profile。

dsh-token-billing shows session and workspace costs beneath the DeepSeek Harness web composer. It calculates token charges using built-in flash/pro prices and Beijing peak/off-peak periods. The ledger persists across restarts. Hover for usage and model totals. Requires webServer and storageDomain.
想在 DSH Web 输入框下方看到当前会话花了多少 token 费用。
我想按工作区查看模型调用成本，并能展开看全局汇总。
How can I see per-session token costs and model usage in the DeepSeek Harness web UI?
dsh-token-billing 的功能「会话与工作区费用读数」：在 Web composer 下方显示当前会话及所属工作区费用；没有当前会话时显示全部会话总额，并标注当前高峰或空闲时段。
dsh-token-billing 的功能「用量和费用明细」：悬停计费读数行可查看调用次数、输入与输出 token、缓存命中、分模型成本、工作区汇总和内置单价表。

dsh-token-billing README · dsh-token-billing：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A token billing plugin for DeepSeek Harness: records every model call at DeepSeek's official pricing and shows a billing readout row in the ambient stats band under the Web UI input box.

dsh-token-billing README · Features：- Session and owning-workspace cost totals: the row names the workspace inline and follows workspace switches; hover adds the all-sessions global totals
- Separate peak / off-peak pricing (Beijing time 9:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00 are peak; off-peak is half the peak price)
- The ledger persists in the `token_billing` storage-domain domain and survives restarts
- Hover the readout row for the full breakdown: session and global cost, token usage, per-model stats, workspace list, price table

dsh-token-billing README · Install：Requires a profile composing the web app (e.g. `dsh --profile web`; the plugin injects the `webServer` and `storageDomain` services and registers in the browser plugin table, all provided by the `dsh-web-app` bundle):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:jianzhexu/dsh-token-billing
```

dsh-token-billing README · Install：Installing activates it: the plugin row mounts through the bundle's own patch layer — no manual config editing. The plugin is plain JavaScript with no build step, so git installs need no pnpm build authorization (`allowBuilds`).

dsh-token-billing README · Uninstall & override：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> remove dsh-token-billing
```

To override config or disable the row, target row id `token-billing` in your profile's own `cordis.patch.yml`.

dsh-token-billing README · Pricing source：<https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing> (prices are built into the plugin and updated per release; models not listed on the pricing page are not billed)
